title: VTG Playboy Magazine May 1986 Complete With Centerfold Woman Fire Fighter
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy Magazine from May 1986, featuring a centerfold of a woman who is a firefighter. It is a physical magazine in English, with a distribution by paid circulation. The magazine falls under the genre of women and men's interest, and is a collector's edition as well as a 1st edition. This specific issue is from the United States and is not signed nor personalized.
